LanguageData.HE_Inti_Pachamanca.label: pachamanca
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Pachamanca.description: Meat, potatoes, sweet maize and broad beans cooked slowly under hot stones and herbs, served steaming with a sharp green pepper sauce.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Locro.label: locro
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Locro.description: A thick stew of corn, potato and squash, slow cooked in a clay pot. Every mountain village has its own way of making it.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Humita.label: humitas
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Humita.description: Fresh ground corn mixed with fat and spice, wrapped in husks and steamed. Shared by neighbours who worked the terraces together. A small treat: eating it is a little joy.
